readOnlyRoutes.reason: The private Journal Discipline Score GET projection now requires the separate default-off reputation-scoring-consent authority before any evidence window is selected or score is computed. The route still accepts no query parameters or client identity, requires strict session revocation, bounded rate limiting, verified tenant/principal context, active binding, private no-store caching and explicit fail-closed authority behavior. Missing consent returns a bounded conflict and creates no score, public ranking or downstream decision. Updated for roadmap 7.1.3 (multi-tenant #20): this GET now passes its request to resolveTenantPrincipalContext, so a bound white-label host resolves to that tenant instead of falling through to the platform default. A host naming no bound domain asserts nothing and the route resolves exactly as before. The only source change is request: req at the call site; no control changed, which is why this entry is re-pinned rather than rewritten.
